calls.bash: mu sql --write "SELECT t.local_id, t.impact, a.name FROM tasks t JOIN agents a ON a.id = t.owner_id JOIN workstreams w ON w.id = t.workstream_id WHERE w.name = 'eval' AND t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY t.impact DESC"

mu sql --write "
INSERT INTO task_notes (task_id, author, content, created_at)
SELECT t.id, 'orchestrator', 'top owner: w2', datetime('now') FROM tasks t JOIN workstreams w ON w.id = t.workstream_id WHERE w.name = 'eval' AND t.local_id = 's4'
"
